breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the erroneous statement: 'Assume the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface where bending normal stress is maximum.' The ground truth removes this incorrect assumption entirely, since torsional shear stress is actually maximum at the outer surface of a solid circular shaft. The agent failed to identify and remove this inconsistency, instead copying it directly from the incomplete prompt.
